name: Strange Bedfellows
source:
Escape the room.

A few weeks' exploration in making visual novels. A story about differences and how we reconcile them.

[From [url=https://strangebedfellows.itch.io/game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
逃出房間。

這是一次為期數週的嘗試，想探索視覺小說究竟可以怎麼做。故事講述差異，以及我們如何調和差異。

[來源：[url=https://strangebedfellows.itch.io/game]itch.io[/url]]
